description.value: Whipple Tree Bakery is a bakery on Menzies Street in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, a short ride from the Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park. The Facebook page indicates it is a recently established business. As a neighbourhood bakery, it could offer a convenient stop for cyclists seeking fresh baked goods while exploring Victoria.
